GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up round h/turn. When quest re tactics, in particular near 900m, where elected to remain on rail & risk being held up with runners improving to outside, rather than shifting wider to obtain clear run, Rdr explained instructed to find cover if possible as mount had a tendency to over-race & with genuine speed of race, allowed mount to continue to travel comfortably before improving in h/straight when inside run presented. Tnr Rep said instruct to be positively & gelding to settle where comfortable-added rider having not ridden gelding previously, & being somewhat difficult, was satisfied.
